basis: Defined by deficient adrenal cortical hormone production; no other organ damage is intrinsic across the umbrella.
Clinically significant ivermectin poisoning predominantly causes CNS toxicity; gastrointestinal symptoms alone do not establish organ damage.
Brain malformations, intellectual disability, coloboma and progressive joint stiffness define the syndrome; hydroureter/hydronephrosis occur in 30-79%.
Chronic hepatitis and developmental delay define the syndrome; growth retardation alone does not establish endocrine disease.
Acute infectious inflammation of the frontal sinus; sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis.
Developmental epileptic encephalopathy with cerebral atrophy and hypomyelination; structural foot deformity in 3/3 and hip dislocation in 2/3 support skeletal involvement.
HPV-associated dysplastic papules of genital skin; malignant progression is uncommon and is not an additional organ label.
Severe congenital neutropenia causes marrow maturation failure and deficient innate immunity; anorectal abscess is a separately diagnosed infection.
Carcinoma confined to the uterus, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Pathologically dilated veins within the colon define the disease; portal hypertension and hepatic disease are explicitly absent.
Coenzyme Q10 biosynthesis disorder with encephalopathy, developmental delay, ataxia and seizures in 3/3; nystagmus does not establish intrinsic ocular damage.
Nonsyndromic hereditary hearing loss; hearing impairment reported in 2/2.
Inherited deficiency of exocrine pancreatic digestive enzymes causes lipid malabsorption; no additional pancreatic structural disease is required.
Defined by progressive nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss.
Progressive myoclonic epilepsy with seizures, myoclonus and frequent cognitive deterioration; no separate organ damage established.
Developmental epileptic encephalopathy with cerebral atrophy; optic atrophy directly damages vision and is reported in 1/1, although evidence is limited.
Presynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder; fixed foot deformities occur in 70-80% and distal amyotrophy in 40%; hearing impairment is only 20%.
Carcinoma in situ originates in the anal canal.
Cutaneous systemic histiocytosis with hypogonadism/diabetes; sensorineural hearing loss in 8/11. Frequent contractures and other systemic manifestations omitted under the four-axis cap.
Left ventricular myocardial noncompaction defines the disease; associated septal defects and arrhythmias remain within the cardiovascular axis.
Abnormal urine reflux involves bladder and ureters, both renal-axis structures; urinary infection is a separate disease.
Carcinoma in situ originates in the liver; biliary structures also belong to the hepatic axis.
Defined anatomically as a disorder of the midbrain.
Immunodeficiency, neutropenia/myelokathexis and characteristic warts define WHIM; respiratory infections are separate diseases and bronchiectasis occurs in only 5-29%.
Cerebrovascular pathology causes ischemic or hemorrhagic injury of the basal ganglia; both brain tissue and its vessels define the condition.
